The cover page of the Klausur (PDF page 233: student code, instructions) is left out, as are the answer boxes and grid paper; points are omitted in both languages. German original in the .orig.txt file, English translation made for this bank. The answer table for e) on page 271 is printed already filled in with values (apparently the solution leaked into the problem section of the book); it is omitted entirely, only the question and the hint are kept. The structure options of i) are one figure (checkboxes in printed left-to-right order).
